Package com.lemarketjames.holdings

Class SettlementControlController

java.lang.Object
com.lemarketjames.holdings.SettlementControlController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/internal/holdings/control/settlement-faults/{accountId}") @ConditionalOnProperty(prefix="lmj.settlement", name="control-enabled", havingValue="true") public class SettlementControlController extends Object
Test control for settlement: make the settlements of one account fail part-way, and let them work again, so failure handling can be tested on a running stack.

Only exists when lmj.settlement.control-enabled=true (test environments), and lives under /internal, which no gateway routes: like the settlement endpoint itself, it is reachable only by calling holdings-service directly on its own port.
